liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): Listener praises the performance of this specific track during the concert [13]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Listener singles out the rendition of this song as a highlight [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-01-29.141938.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-01-29.167913.EC-7.OldNeumanntapr.flac1644**: source not stated; 20 songs; 129 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1987-01-29.140690.ultramatrix.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Ambient microphones are turned on at 1:06 of Hell In A Bucket [3]
- **gd1987-01-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83284.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 2.25/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording quality as great sounding [15]

## Around the show

- Listener praises Brent's playing during the performance [13]
- Weir sings as if he cannot remember how his own jaw works [14]
- Jerry announces in a mocking voice that Bob has trouble with his guitar [15]
- Brent shines by trying to compensate for Bobby's performance issues [15]
- Chinese New Year music played before the band started their set [18]
- Weir performed shortly after his dog died, which the reviewer notes [18]
- Garcia had recently recovered from a diabetic coma before these shows [18]
- A large balloon sculpture hung from the ceiling for Chinese New Year [2]
- Reviewer compares it to the previous day, noting worse bad parts and less good parts [14]
- Reviewer states this show is much better than the previous day's performance [16]
- Show started bumpy, threatening to repeat last night's disappointment, but improved by mid-set [19]
- Performance began poorly, risking a repeat of the previous night, but became excellent [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-01-29.141938.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Modified Sony F-1 PCM; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown… [1]. Also: Credit given to Oade brothers for master recordings and hard disk transfer [1]
- **gd1987-01-29.167913.EC-7.OldNeumanntapr.flac1644**: taped by OldNeumanntapr; transferred by OldNeumanntapr; source: OTS Balcony; Superscope EC-7 Cardioids (Near Coincident) >Sony TC-153SD Cassette Master >CDR >FLAC [2]. Also: Reviewer thanks the uploader for the taping details and the recording itself [21]
- **gd1987-01-29.140690.ultramatrix.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [3]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to make the show complete [3]
- **gd1987-01-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83284.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90/Sony D5) [4]. Also: Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for providing the tapes [4]
